4.1 Advanced Exercise

The Advanced Researcher: Bringing it all together

Let’s bring this all together and create an Expert who has access to company-specific information in a document and who can come up with a plan for us given this data.

Create a new chat and upload this document: Employee Feedback.

  • Upload a document

  • Get the bot to reason through it step by step

  • Generate ideas to improve our company based on this feedback

  • Generate ideas for a digital product to improve the company based on your insights

  • Identify potenital risks related to this product

  • Come up with the main features, user story/stories and acceptance criteria for the first sprint

Share a short overview of your first sprint on the Miro board under the “Advanced” section
